title: SAML login fails after identity provider certificate renewal
description: All users see invalid signature when signing in through SSO. The identity provider rotated its signing certificate yesterday; password login still works.
resolution: An administrator uploaded the renewed IdP signing certificate to the SAML configuration, verified the certificate fingerprint, and tested SSO with a pilot user before restoring access for everyone.

title: Single sign on redirects in a login loop
description: Users return to the sign-in page repeatedly after the identity provider URL changed. The SAML assertion audience does not match the configured entity ID.
resolution: Corrected the SAML entity ID and assertion consumer service URL to match the identity provider configuration. A fresh browser session completed sign-in.

title: New user denied SSO because email claim is missing
description: Only recently provisioned users cannot sign in. SAML assertions omit the email attribute required to match existing accounts.
resolution: Added the email claim mapping in the identity provider and reprovisioned the affected test user. Existing user accounts were preserved.

title: CSV export shows sales on the previous day
description: Daily sales dates in a CSV download differ from the dashboard by one day. The export used UTC while the store dashboard uses America/Los_Angeles timezone.
resolution: Set the export timezone to the store timezone and regenerated the report. Validated transactions around local midnight and a daylight-saving boundary.

title: CSV monetary values split across columns in Excel
description: Opening a sales export in a locale that uses comma decimal separators splits currency amounts into extra columns. The CSV delimiter and spreadsheet import settings differ.
resolution: Imported the CSV using an explicit comma delimiter, quoted text qualifier, and dot decimal separator. Shared the import steps with the reporting team.

title: Large CSV export times out before download completes
description: A yearly transaction export exceeds the synchronous download timeout. Smaller weekly exports complete successfully.
resolution: Split the export by month for the immediate delivery. Used the asynchronous export job for subsequent full-year downloads and confirmed row counts.

title: BigQuery connector receives 403 reading dataset tables
description: The service account can connect to Google Cloud but gets access denied when selecting tables in a newly created BigQuery dataset. Dataset permissions do not include the connector account.
resolution: The customer's cloud administrator granted the connector service account the required read access on the intended dataset, then tested a limited query. No project-wide admin grant was needed.

title: BigQuery query fails with bigquery.jobs.create permission denied
description: Dataset table access is present, but queries fail with 403 because the service account lacks permission to create query jobs in the billing project.
resolution: Confirmed the query billing project and asked its administrator to grant the approved job-creation permission there. Re-ran a small query and checked its billing project.

title: BigQuery dataset location does not match query region
description: A connector query reports dataset not found although the table exists. The dataset is in EU and the configured query location is US.
resolution: Changed the connector query region to the dataset location and verified the authorized cross-region data policy before retrying.

title: Bulk API synchronization triggers HTTP 429 rate limits
description: Parallel REST API requests during a bulk catalog sync exceed the request quota. Immediate retries cause a sustained burst of 429 responses.
resolution: Reduced client concurrency, honored Retry-After, and used capped exponential backoff with jitter. Confirmed the sync completed without retry storms.

title: API requests fail with 401 after key rotation
description: An integration continues sending the previous API key after credentials were rotated. The new key succeeds in a manual test.
resolution: Updated the integration secret reference, restarted only the affected worker, and revoked the obsolete key after verifying successful authenticated requests.

title: API pagination repeats the first page of sales records
description: The client restarts each request without the next cursor returned by the sales endpoint. The import repeatedly loads the same first page.
resolution: Persisted and passed the returned next cursor until it was absent. Deduplicated the repeated import by source record ID and verified total counts.

title: Duplicate webhook events create repeated orders
description: The order callback is delivered more than once when the receiver acknowledges slowly. Each delivery has the same event ID but the consumer writes a new row.
resolution: Added idempotent handling keyed by event ID, acknowledged after durable enqueue, and replayed duplicate deliveries to confirm only one order was created.

title: Webhook signature validation fails after body parsing
description: Valid events are rejected because the receiver reconstructs JSON before checking the signature. Whitespace changes alter the signed bytes.
resolution: Verified the signature against the raw request body before parsing JSON and checked the configured signing secret. Added a replay test with exact payload bytes.

title: Webhook delivery stops after endpoint responds with redirects
description: The callback endpoint was moved and now returns a redirect instead of a successful acknowledgement. Recent events remain in the retry queue.
resolution: Updated the registered callback to the final HTTPS endpoint, tested delivery, and replayed queued events using the existing idempotency check.

title: Retail connector data stale after OAuth refresh token expires
description: No new orders arrive in the dashboard. Connector logs show invalid_grant when refreshing its OAuth token; the source application revoked the old consent.
resolution: An authorized customer administrator reconnected the source account and granted the approved scopes. Resumed the sync from its saved watermark and checked for gaps and duplicates.

title: Connector freshness delayed by upstream maintenance
description: The sales feed has no new batches while the upstream provider is in maintenance. Authentication succeeds and the last completed watermark is intact.
resolution: Confirmed the provider maintenance window, paused aggressive retries, and resumed incremental ingestion when the provider recovered. Verified backlog clearance and source totals.

title: Connector rejects new records after source schema change
description: New batches fail validation because the retail source renamed the store_id column. Older records continue to display on dashboards.
resolution: Updated the source-to-canonical field mapping, validated a sample batch, and replayed the failed interval with duplicate protection.

title: Scheduled report email missing from team inbox
description: The daily report job shows delivered but recipients in a distribution group cannot find the message. The mail gateway quarantines the sender domain.
resolution: The customer's mail administrator checked quarantine and approved the report sender according to their mail policy. Sent a test report and verified delivery to the distribution group.

title: Scheduled daily report runs at the wrong local time
description: A report arrives one hour late after a daylight-saving transition. Its schedule was defined as a fixed UTC offset instead of a named timezone.
resolution: Changed the schedule to the customer's named timezone and checked the next run time on both sides of the daylight-saving transition.

title: Scheduled report disabled when its owner leaves
description: A weekly report stops running after the owner account is deactivated. The schedule is still tied to that user's permissions.
resolution: Transferred ownership to an approved active reporting account, reviewed dataset permissions, and ran a test before re-enabling the weekly schedule.

title: Dashboard total differs from sum of rounded rows
description: Adding displayed sales rows gives a slightly different total than the KPI. Rows are rounded to two decimals while the total aggregates unrounded amounts.
resolution: Explained the aggregate-then-round behavior and exposed full precision in the reconciliation export. Confirmed the discrepancy was display rounding rather than missing transactions.

title: Dashboard currency conversion uses unexpected exchange rate date
description: Converted revenue in USD differs from the finance spreadsheet. The dashboard uses the transaction-day FX rate while the spreadsheet uses month-end rates.
resolution: Agreed the reporting currency and exchange-rate convention with finance, applied the approved transaction-day setting, and documented the reconciliation difference.

title: Dashboard revenue includes tax while finance export excludes it
description: Daily revenue differs consistently from the finance report by the tax amount. One view uses gross sales and the other net sales.
resolution: Aligned the metric definition to the agreed net revenue field and checked a sample of transactions including refunds. Added a clear metric description to the dashboard.
